Driver script + [SELFHOST] phase= markers supported; run ends ACCEPTANCE-COMPLETE + clean System halt.

blockers: MAKE.BIN (ported GNU make) faults at execve+0x4 (ELR 0x100002A5FC, EC 0x20 instr abort) as soon as it runs an actual recipe: make exec's its recipe shell and the kernel's v2 exec tears down the old AS before mapping the (missing /bin/sh) target, leaving the process AS-less per the documented 'no state change' deviation (program_loader.c process_exec_current) - reproduced IDENTICALLY on the base w3 kernel (b27f4ec) with a lane A/B probe, i.e. NOT introduced by this lane.  w3's in-OS MAKE.BIN run never hit it because its Makefile.hobbyos was absent (make stops before running recipes).  Implication for w4-src S0-S3: the in-OS make must find its recipe shell at the path make's SHELL points to (or the exec-failure AS-restore bug must be fixed in a future kernel lane).  MODE=selfhost itself is unaffected (proven with HELLO).

design_note.mission_a_serial_path: No new syscall or fd machinery was needed: MODE=selfhost is a boot-wave single-program load like JSC/WEBPROC, so fd 1/2 are unset and the pre-existing console-fd fallback (fs.c file_write 0002 -> console_write_user -> uart_putc) already routes stdout/stderr to serial.  The driver's own emit() uses print_console (SYS_WRITE_CONSOLE -> console_write_user -> serial).  Both paths verified end-to-end on serial.
design_note.mission_b_fix_scope: Two self-contained src/kernel/fat16.c changes (free-cluster alloc hint; bulk truncate_to extension that walks the chain once and zero-fills only the partial tail cluster, exploiting alloc_cluster's pre-zeroing for POSIX zero-fill semantics).  Deliberately NOT changed: the block driver's per-512B request loop (affects every I/O path on both arches - out of bounded scope).  The W4_MKFS_PROBE=1 knob + gated probe stays in-tree so any future lane can re-measure the curve in one boot.
